summary: Phase 4 (scroll, popups, SEO/GEO, JSON-LD, robots/sitemap/llms.txt, FAQ + CMS, favicon) tested end-to-end on the preview URL. New pytest suite test_phase4_seo_faq.py 29/29 passed (all 13 public pages: unique Spanish title/description, one H1, canonical/og:url https://espacioq.es/..., hreflang es-ES, og:image 1200x630, twitter summary_large_image, geo meta, meta robots noindex,nofollow + X-Robots-Tag noindex on preview, #jsonld-salon on every page, no aggregateRating/review; #jsonld-service Service+BreadcrumbList; #jsonld-faq 6 Q&As matching SSR <details>; robots.txt 12 UA groups with identical disallows; sitemap 36 URLs all with lastmod incl. FAQ/services; llms.txt has address/Chueca/metro/hours/phone/prices/booking+FAQ URLs; favicon/icons/manifest/og image 200 with correct types and sizes (ico 16/32/48, apple 180, 192, 512, maskable 512, og 1200x630)). Host logic verified locally: Host espacioq.es / www.espacioq.es -> index,follow and no X-Robots-Tag; other hosts -> noindex. Playwright: booking wizard steps 1->2->3->4->5->confirmation each land with the wizard top just below the 81px sticky header (scrollY 309, step H2 visible) even when clicked from far down (scrollY 1012-1593); manage page (390x844) reschedule/Volver/cancel/cancelled-message all scroll to manage card top below header; header/footer link navigation from page bottom -> scrollY 0; browser Back restored /servicios scrollY 1500; skip link, home hero anchor (#intro-salon, target top 80) and services chapter index still work. Popups at 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080: promo (sh=ch=568) and newsletter (sh=ch=661) fully inside viewport, no inner scroll; 375x812 unchanged and fits. FAQ: SSR answers, first item open by default, Enter/Space toggle summary, Tab moves between summaries; footer-faq-link works. Admin /admin/contenido/page_faq: edit answer, remove item, add item, reorder, save draft (public unchanged), publish (public updated, revision v2 recorded), remove all + publish -> faq-empty-state shown, jsonld-faq omitted, still 1 H1. Original 6 items restored and published as v4 (verified byte-identical to pre-test publishedData; draft equals published; hasUnpublished=false). Regression: cookie banner accept -> Google map iframe loads on /contacto, home loads, booking flow creates & cancels booking, Vitest 68/68 passed. No functional defects found.

issues: 'Otra fecha en calendario' still uses the native browser <input type=date> picker (pre-existing, not Phase 4) instead of a styled calendar component
